Package net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.base.extension.enums

package net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.base.extension.enums
Enumeration SPI for the WordPress domain.

Defines FriendlyEnum with its value() contract — the wire value used in REST requests and JSON (e.g., pending). Twelve extension points build on it: PostTypeEnum, PostStatusEnum, QueryParamEnum, CacheKeyEnum and others. Default implementations live in net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.models.schema and net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.models.taxonomies.

Since:
0.1.0
